subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Romance Baiting Scam
description: A quick, practical guide to The Romance Baiting Scam.

hook.text: Your online partner of six months asks for money. You've never met in person.

buildup.text: Romance scammers build deep emotional connections over weeks before making any financial request.

discovery.text: They use stolen photos and scripted conversations, often managing dozens of victims at once.

twist.text: Victims lose an average of $10,000 — but some have lost their life savings over years.

climax.text: The emotional damage often exceeds the financial loss. Victims grieve a person who never existed.

punchline.text: The relationship was real. The person wasn't.

quiz.question: How much does the average romance scam victim lose?
